INSERT INTO tasks ( task_id, project_id, parent_task_id, milestone_id, task_type_id, task_status_id, title, content, assignee_user_id, priority_code, est_start_date, est_end_date, start_date, due_date, estimated_hours, progress_rate, created_at ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{projectId}, #{parentTaskId}, #{milestoneId}, #{taskTypeId}, #{taskStatusId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{assigneeUserId}, #{priorityCode}, #{estStartDate}, #{estEndDate}, #{startDate}, #{dueDate}, #{estimatedHours}, #{progressRate}, sysdate )
INSERT INTO task_rejections ( task_rejection_id, task_id, rejection_reason, rejected_by, rejection_date ) VALUES ( task_rejection_seq.NEXTVAL, #{taskId}, #{rejectionReason}, #{rejectedBy}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, task_status_id = #{taskStatusId}, priority_code = #{priorityCode}, assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId}, progress_rate = #{progressRate}, actual_hours = #{actualHours}, start_date = #{startDate}, due_date = #{dueDate}, updated_at = SYSDATE, editor_user_id = #{editorUserId} WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.task_id as taskId, t.project_id as projectId, t.task_type_id as taskTypeId, t.title, t.content, t.assignee_user_id as assigneeUserId, u.user_name as assigneeName, t.task_status_id as taskStatusId, t.priority_code as priorityCode, t.milestone_id as milestoneId, t.start_date as startDate, t.due_date as dueDate, t.actual_hours as actualHours, t.progress_rate as progressRate, t.est_start_date as estStartDate, t.est_end_date as estEndDate, t.estimated_hours as estimatedHours FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN users u ON t.assignee_user_id = u.user_id WHERE t.task_id = #{taskId}
SELECT t.*, u.user_name AS assigneeName FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN users u ON t.assignee_user_id = u.user_id WHERE t.is_deleted = 'Q1'
SELECT project_id, project_name, parent_project_id FROM projects WHERE status = 'F1'
SELECT user_id AS userId, user_name AS userName FROM users WHERE is_active = 'O1' AND user_type = 'M2'
SELECT task_type_id, type_name FROM task_types WHERE is_active = 'O1'
SELECT task_status_id, status_name FROM task_statuses WHERE is_active = 'O1'
SELECT m.milestone_id AS milestoneId, m.milestone_name AS milestoneName FROM milestones m WHERE m.project_id = #{projectId}
